the flowering dates of the four investigated shrub species in Germany are significantly influenced by temperature and precipitation extremes during the preceding autumn, winter, and spring, with a particularly strong effect of extremely warm spring temperatures on the timing of flowering.

the flowering of the studied shrub species is significantly influenced by early spring temperatures as well as by autumn temperatures and that the influence of temperature extremes is stronger than that of precipitation extremes.
